name: publicWeb_reportChatMessage
description: The public web's door to HC6.hcapp_reportChatMessage (E9.F1.S16/S17, report a chat message to the platform reviewers). A thin 'wrap for writes' wrapper: it EXECs hcapp_reportChatMessage with the browser's own device credentials and adds no checks of its own, so the web and the app cannot drift. Auth, permission gate and every rule live in hcapp_reportChatMessage (the token must be signed for 'hcapp_reportChatMessage', because the inner SP validates under its own name). Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. Returns hcapp_reportChatMessage's rowsets unchanged.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_reportChatMessage' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The message reported. Required in effect: NULL or unknown → 1987 'That message is no longer in the chat.'; the caller's own → 1987 'That is your own message.' Passed straight to hcapp_reportChatMessage.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional free text, up to 1,000 characters (LEN); longer → 1987. MAX on purpose so it is refused, never truncated. Stored inside LOG.GeneralLog.Data and emailed. Passed straight to hcapp_reportChatMessage.

rowsets.description: From hcapp_reportChatMessage: Auth failure only (ValidateAppAuth): the error detail is returned ALONE at index 0 and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_reportChatMessage: Every other refusal: {success 0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0, then the StandardErrorResult detail at index 1. Codes: 1987 bad request — own message, message not found, or reason over 1,000 (errorType 2; errorUserMessage says which); 1988 unhandled error from the CATCH (5).
From hcapp_reportChatMessage: Follows the ErrorEnvelope on every non-auth refusal.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_reportChatMessage: On success: the standard success envelope. success is 1 whether the report was new or a repeat.

rowsets.name: Report
rowsets.description: From hcapp_reportChatMessage: On success, API ONLY (stripped from the client reply): the report for the email. One row (reporter × sender).

columns.name: ReporterEmail
columns.description: The caller's Hasher.Email (NOT NULL in the table; may be a generated address — the API mailer refuses those, GeneratedEmail.Is).

columns.name: ThreadLabel
columns.description: '<KennelShortName> — <EventName>' for a run, '<KennelShortName> kennel chat', 'DM: <sender> ↔ <other>' for a DM (from the SENDER's HasherFriendMap row), or the room's RoomName. NULL if the lookup finds nothing.

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent — the text, or the photo/location URL (raw, not the preview).

columns.name: AlreadyReported
columns.description: 1 when this reporter already reported this message (a LOG.GeneralLog row with LogSource 'HC6.hcapp_reportChatMessage' whose Data starts with 'message=<id> reporter=<id>'); the API then sends no email.

rowsets.name: Reviewers
rowsets.description: From hcapp_reportChatMessage: On success, API ONLY: who receives the email. HC.PlatformAdmin rows (removed 0, CanEditKennel 1) joined to a live Hasher with a non-empty Email, UNION the shared mailbox literal. Same rule as publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest.

sideEffects: INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (LogSource 'HC6.hcapp_reportChatMessage', Message 'Chat message reported', StrParam1 = reporter id, Data = key + sender + thread label + reason + text, LEFT(…, 4000)) — first report per (message, reporter) only.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1987 and in the CATCH (1988).
The API emails rowset 1 to every rowset-2 address unless AlreadyReported = 1; nothing is queued in the database.
PublicWebAdminApi emails the report (rowset 1) to the reviewers (rowset 2) via AbuseReportEmails after the SP returns.

On an error that escapes the inner SP (or the EXEC itself) the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_reportChatMessage' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and re-THROWs, so the API returns 500.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken (line 13-14) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
